name: MultiPlaneNeRF
definition: A NeRF model that uses non-trainable representations of 3D objects by projecting 3D points onto 2D images. It solves the problems of long training times and poor generalization to unseen data found in vanilla NeRF.
summary: MultiPlaneNeRF is a radiance field representation that replaces trainable 3D parameters with a fixed set of pre-existing 2D images to solve vanilla NeRF's long training times and poor generalization.
